init.title: Plex Extended options
init.description: Choose the default Plex user and whether this server contributes native Plex Extended tools to Assist. Watch-state, playlist, and account Watchlist writes are separate opt-ins.

data.allow_llm_mutations: Allow Assist to change Plex watch state
data.allow_llm_watchlist_mutations: Allow Assist to change Plex Watchlist
data.allow_llm_playlist_mutations: Allow Assist to change Plex playlists

data_description.enable_llm_tools: When disabled, this Plex server is omitted from all native Plex Extended Assist tools. Manual Home Assistant actions remain available. Existing installations default to enabled.
data_description.allow_llm_mutations: When native Assist tools are enabled, this additionally exposes mark-watched and mark-unwatched tools to Assist. Manual Home Assistant actions remain available regardless of either setting.
data_description.allow_llm_watchlist_mutations: When native Assist tools are enabled, this exposes add/remove Plex Watchlist tools for the configured plex.tv account. It is disabled by default and is separate from household-user watch-state writes.
data_description.allow_llm_playlist_mutations: When native Assist tools are enabled, this exposes create/add/remove regular playlist tools for the selected/default Plex user. It is disabled by default, uses exact Plex rating keys, and does not permit smart or radio playlist edits.

error.invalid_user_context: Plex Extended could not access this server as the selected user. The configured Plex account must be the server owner to switch users.

abort.not_loaded: Plex Extended must be loaded before its options can be changed.
abort.cannot_load_users: Plex Extended could not load Plex users from this server.
